name: ARB
description: ARB is an advanced reasoning benchmark composed of challenging problems across multiple fields including mathematics, physics, biology, chemistry, and law, designed to test large language models beyond existing benchmarks with a rubric-based evaluation approach.
reputation: A niche but respected reasoning benchmark used in LLM evaluation research, especially for harder multi-domain reasoning beyond standard QA sets.
notes: Includes a challenging subset requiring advanced symbolic reasoning; uses rubric-based evaluation with GPT-4 scoring intermediate reasoning steps; human evaluation shows promising agreement.
